# Grammatical Aspect

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GrammaticalAspect>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The grammatical aspect of an event mention in text — a VALUE vocabulary for ISO-TimeML interoperability (perfective / progressive / perfective-progressive / none).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the grammatical-aspect axis of an event MENTION in text (perfective / progressive / perfective-progressive / none) — for ISO-TimeML interoperability.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to express the event's real temporal structure (that is the dating properties); aspect is a textual-realization facet, never inferred from or to actual placement.

### How to use

- Reference a [`gmeow:GrammaticalAspect`](gmeow-GrammaticalAspect.md) individual from a textual event mention via [`gmeow:eventAspect`](../properties/gmeow-eventAspect.md); keep it on the annotation layer.

### Examples

- ex:mention [`gmeow:eventAspect`](../properties/gmeow-eventAspect.md) [`gmeow:aspectProgressive`](../individuals/gmeow-aspectProgressive.md).
